scope: Full stack through stage separation; first-stage booster only afterward.
clock: Elapsed seconds from liftoff. Official preflight approximate times are adopted as A-class simulation commands, not measured actual times or onboard thresholds.

M1.title: SpaceX CRS-10 Dragon Resupply Mission press kit, February 2017
M1.locator: PDF p.2, Mission Timeline (all times approximate)
M1.scope: Official published preflight schedule; no actual cutoff thresholds or restart state vectors.

M2.title: SpaceX CRS-10 Technical Webcast, 19 February 2017
M2.scope: Primary flight record. No frame-by-frame event timing was measured for this revision.

M3.title: shahar603 Telemetry-Data CRS-10 mission README
M3.scope: Author reports MECO at 143 s, altitude 63.082 km and speed 1675.209 m/s. Analysed telemetry is labelled Stage 2. Not adopted as an exact first-stage state or flight command.

initial_state.basis: Earth-centred launch-aligned frame; base at [0,0,R] externally. Body +x nose. Initial base at rest relative Earth; initial CG velocity includes moving CG. Masses from Falcon9Parameters.

shutdown.basis: Quintic smooth envelope required by the existing continuous-flow dynamics. Completion anchored to the published 141 s MECO; duration is not measured. Check 0.5, 1 and 2 s sensitivity.

transitions.name: shutdown_start
transitions.basis: 141 s reference minus assumed 1 s shutdown.

transitions.name: meco
transitions.basis: Completion of smooth shutdown, not instantaneously discontinuous flow.

transitions.name: stage_separation
transitions.basis: Existing zero-impulse, no-discard-mass state map; preserve fixed structural points.

transitions.name: boostback_end
transitions.basis: Burn end must be supplied from verified footage or a declared return-target condition with smooth shutdown. No duration invented.

transitions.name: entry_end
transitions.basis: Burn end needs a sourced time or an explicit speed/thermal-envelope design target. No duration invented.

transitions.name: touchdown
transitions.basis: First descending crossing of landing-contact height, not a forced clock stop. Evaluate pre-contact velocity and attitude; no state reset to create a successful landing.

reference_markers.name: max_q
reference_markers.use: Comparison marker only. Detect the simulated dynamic-pressure maximum independently.

reference_markers.name: stage2_ignition
reference_markers.use: Upper vehicle; not a first-stage restart.

reference_markers.name: seco
reference_markers.use: Upper vehicle; outside tracked booster scope.

reference_markers.name: dragon_separation
reference_markers.use: Dragon from second stage, not first/second-stage separation.

landing_criteria.basis: Provisional project acceptance limits for a near-stationary upright contact. Not Falcon 9 certified limits; evaluate 0.5x and 2x sensitivity.
landing_criteria.unresolved: Define deployed landing-leg contact geometry and LZ-1 in the chosen initial reference before running a landing case. Tail-base height zero is not assumed to be leg contact.

integration.basis: Accepted steps aligned to fixed 100 Hz IMU, 10 Hz GNSS/LiDAR, output and event boundaries. No random sampling during RK4 trial evaluations.
integration.attitude_source: truth; current C filter does not estimate attitude
integration.sensor_settings_basis: Existing C-class defaults, including placeholder noise; not certified Falcon 9 sensors.

unresolved_before_full_flight: Physical TVC/RCS actuator model and surveyed landing-site geometry.
Independent validation of the calibrated ascent operating point and pitch program.
Robust recovery success under coefficient, mass, wind and navigation uncertainty.
Restart health/settling and deployed-leg inertia/contact-force dynamics.
Validate the final sensor/filter settings and explicitly document the truth-attitude and truth-state-feedback interfaces.

attitude_program.basis: A: ascent uses the existing unlimited ideal pitch-control couple. tau100 s is calibrated to the same reference readout, not independently validated guidance. Heading45 deg is a northeast ISS-launch approximation. Recovery actuators are bounded separately.

terminal_test.basis: Independent terminal powered-descent integration fixture, not a state inherited from CRS-10 return. Initial altitude within the existing C LiDAR range (1800 m), tail down and centred engine to test retro-flow aero, braking, mass depletion and sensor interfaces. Fuel inventory and throttle are provisional assumptions; no claim of a complete landing. Legs/fins deployed for booster_landing configuration.

recovery.basis: Project-designed feedback return, not reconstructed SpaceX flight software. True state feedback for A/B verification; navigation feedback not yet used.
recovery.target_basis: A: rounded 14 km south / 6 km east launch-relative pad target on sphere, not surveyed LZ-1 coordinates.
recovery.contact_basis: A: four leg tips 1 m below base and 3.5 m radial; explicit numerical acceptance geometry, not manufacturer dimensions.
recovery.restart_basis: A: engine health, propellant settling and ignition transients not resolved; successful restart is assumed after zero-flow and attitude checks. One-second smooth flow ramp is numerical design, not a measured transient.
recovery.landing_budget_basis: Planning allocation. Unused boostback/entry allocation can transfer to landing; reserve plus limiting-tank residual is protected.
recovery.landing_force_allocation: A: bounded force allocation; landing moment authority uses the existing virtual TVC first and grid fins only for residual demand. Vertical deceleration tracks the lowest leg clearance/rate with rotational corrections. No change to acceptance limits or target coordinates.
recovery.boostback_prediction: A: reduced-order predictor includes central gravity, rotation, B force coefficients and a prospective entry burn. Used for feedback; prediction errors remain.
recovery.landing_margin_basis: A: 1.5 km early-ignition clearance allowance for reduced stopping-predictor and attitude/force uncertainty, selected in development trials; not an actual CRS-10 altitude or validated robustness bound.
